description: Phase 6.4 Activity State Timeline — video_10 representative frames

video_10_sample.note: FP — high-conf background detection passes all gates

design_finding: Activity state classifier v3 correctly identifies ACTIVE_PLAY for 12/18 GT events. 4 GT events in frames 232-294 are DEAD_BALL_VISUAL due to tracker loss (not fixable at Stage 3). 2 GT events are POSSIBLE_POINT_END (soft). Post-rally FPs remain ACTIVE_PLAY because YOLO continues detecting objects at comparable confidence to real ball.
